desc:
🍀 Clover Adventure | Magic Anime RPG 🍀

Roll for your Grimoire, awaken your clan's power and become the strongest mage in all three kingdoms!

Command Time, Gravity, Lightning, Flame, the rare Nightleaf and many more. Hunt mythical beasts, raid dungeons and duel other mages for their bounty!

⚔️ FEATURES:
📖 36 Grimoires to roll, from Common to Mythical
🧬 66 Clans with unique clan abilities
🧹 Broom flight across the Clover, Diamond & Spade kingdoms
🐉 Mythical creatures, world bosses & dungeons
⚒️ Forge your gear up
🤺 PvP duels & bounty hunting
🤝 Trading Hub: trade with other players
👥 Join a Magic Squad and follow the story


🎁 CODES:
GRIMOIRE1 (20 Grimoire Spins)
BONE (20 Grimoire Spins)
UPDATE3 (10 Bloodline Spins)
THANKYOU (10 Grimoire, 10 Clan, 10 Bloodline Spins + 10 Gems)
SPINS1 (15 Grimoire, 15 Clan, 15 Bloodline Spins)

👍 Like & Favorite to support the game!
